searchText: Are there any plans to do cross-client bn<>vc testing on devnet1? might help to catch some issues early. Need to get more feedback on https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/447 Once the network is up, it should be trivial to do cross bn<>vc testing with kurtosis 🙂 Yea we need to settle and agree on electra beacon api spec before we can start doing bn<>vc testing
